issues.finding: Default .14 m and caller shrinking override underbound collision footprint, including at rest. Full XYZ box half diagonal .20199009876724155 m now immutable declared floor/default in both screens.
issues.evidence: 15-test pristine-base run: 19 failures; independent yaw/tilt inside-box oracle and six-speed/tail regressions. No production source modified.

issues.finding: known_free certifies centreline, not entire body. Centre (1,0) can be accepted while physical body point (1,.1) is inside an adjacent unknown sector.
issues.evidence: test_known_free_centerline_does_not_certify_body_containment; independent angle/point-in-box oracle; no occupancy-model workaround added.

issues.finding: Independent position/control/sensor uncertainty bounds are absent. The .09 s term reflects historical contact-to-step-end delay, not calibrated sensing delay or guaranteed pre-contact response.
issues.evidence: EQ-1D REPORT D1-K2; source PhysX contact/rest offsets .002/.001 m retained separately and not silently added as a calibrated uncertainty margin.

issues.finding: Below-2 quadratic table extension understated own zero-command surrogate tail; hard+stop accepted boxes intersected during that response. Safety-only max envelope now prevents this inconsistency.
issues.evidence: Pre-D01 19-test run had 10 failures; .6/1.2 box counterexamples, saturation scalar oracle, reaction-once and discretization tests now PASS. dynamics.py unchanged.

issues.finding: tau=.4 prior underpredicts declared high-speed knot by 12.56050955%; exceeds 10% target, within 25% user-approved continuation threshold.
issues.evidence: Signed three-speed table and unchanged independent 8 s geometric-series oracle. No retuning.

issues.finding: M2 section3 sentence saying the law never brakes below 2 overstates a cap FLOOR as an executed-speed minimum. Zero/.6/1.2 requests remain zero/.6/1.2.
issues.evidence: Original speed_governor.py:465-503 and independent cap test; parent added explicit dated M2 banner preserving historical text below and amendment14. No production change.

issues.finding: Scalar first-order rollout and straight-line braking tail omit actual Lee attitude/motor dynamics, yaw drift, altitude transients and state dependence. Zero command is not instantaneous stop; fallback cannot certify safety.
issues.evidence: Historical EQ-1D exact braking records retained separately; actual desired tilt45deg does not bound measured contact tilt. No new simulator/GPU run or low-speed plant qualification.

issues.finding: Low/above-table distances are uncalibrated extrapolation. Above-3.52 warning is returned by braking_distance, not exposed by safety.screen tuple. Candidate rejection means no feasible sampled action under this model, not physically unavoidable collision.
issues.evidence: Unchanged helper API and finite candidate/centreline nature; no threshold relaxation or false collision-free/inevitability label introduced.
